statement:
by
  classical
  let S := fun {r s : ℕ} (α : DirichletCharacter ℂ r) (β : DirichletCharacter ℂ s) (m : ℕ) =>
    ∑' q : ℕ, if hq : q ≠ 0 then
      let _ : NeZero q := ⟨hq⟩
      if h : r ∣ q ∧ s ∣ q then
        let A := DirichletCharacter.changeLevel h.1 α
        let B := DirichletCharacter.changeLevel h.2 β
        gaussSum A ZMod.stdAddChar * gaussSum B ZMod.stdAddChar *
          gaussSum (A*B)⁻¹ (ZMod.stdAddChar.mulShift (-(m:ZMod q))) / (q.totient:ℂ)^2
      else 0
    else 0
  let O := S (1 : DirichletCharacter ℂ 1) (1 : DirichletCharacter ℂ 1)
  exact ∀ K : ℝ, ∃ F : Finset (Σ s : ℕ, DirichletCharacter ℂ s), (∀ b ∈ F, b.1 ≠ 0 ∧ b.2.IsPrimitive ∧ Squarefree b.1) ∧ K * ‖O 2‖ ^ 2 < ∑ b ∈ F, ‖S (1 : DirichletCharacter ℂ 1) b.2 2‖ ^ 2

plain_statement.zh: 即使固定 m=2、首特征平凡、搭档导子无平方因子，归一化平方和仍可任意大。
plain_statement.en: Unbounded normalized quadratic mass even on squarefree partners at a fixed target.

brief.zh: 检验把 #4245 的三次矩直接降为二次矩会遇到的障碍。取奇素数连乘为共同模数；每个 p 的平方质量因子应为 1+1/(p−2)。须证明普通级数非零并构造有限原始搭档族。该结论可排除一条错误的一致估计路线。
brief.en: Test the endpoint of #4245: choose odd primorial levels, prove the ordinary series is nonzero and realize the finite row factors 1+1/(p−2). Divergence excludes a conductor-independent square bound even for this fixed row.
